setup_abort_policy: The original bag and summary are preserved without edits; one 0.017-second pre-driving abort is not a measured drive.
scenario_profile_note: Pre-driving frozen metadata is preserved, including its original actual_drive_validated=false. This export result records actual driving.
numerical_failure_policy: Off-route attempts and solver failures remain in the data; a failed solve can retain a previous reference. No claim that every solve was valid.
